source: docs/adr/0016-india-borders-on-maps.md. Present-day coordinates, each inside the Natural Earth India point-of-view outline that ADR 0016 names as the source. Every map from 1858 must draw each point inside India and inside no other country; before 1858 inside no other country. The Natural Earth outline holds only the western part of the Shaksgam Valley (it ends near 76.4 E at 36.2 N), so this point sits there.
